items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: And we have a record out together, “In a Word,” Don Friedman, Dennis Irwin, Ralph LaLama and Nicole Pasternak, with no drums.

ctx.x: What’s it like to, is your wife professional? I mean does she make her living singing?

Oh yeah. Well she’s got a day job too, because no, she’s been a professional for a long time. And we have a couple of records. And we have a record out together, “In a Word,” Don Friedman, Dennis Irwin, Ralph LaLama and Nicole Pasternak, with no drums. And

it was totally in a word, now check this out, it’s called “In a Word” and all the titles of the songs are one word: “Smile,” you know, “Four,” “You,” you know I can’t remember everything. But you know it’s like twelve tunes or something, and they’re all one word. So the name of the CD is called “In a Word.”
